outputs.explanation: This is a sequence conservation logo showing amino acid frequency/bits per position across 120 proteins, not a bar chart of means; this plot type does not require overlaid individual data points.
The inhibition zone plot shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each biological replicate overlaid, as also stated in the caption.
This panel consists of epifluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Fluorescence intensity is shown as mean ± SEM with individual cell values overlaid as yellow open circles.
Fluorescence intensity is shown as mean ± SEM with individual cell values overlaid as blue open circles.
This panel shows super-resolution PALM microscopy images of representative cells, not a plot of averaged data.
Number of clusters per cell is shown as mean ± SEM with individual cell values overlaid as gray dots.
Cluster sizes are shown as mean ± SEM with individual cluster values overlaid as gray dots.
Proportion of molecules in clusters per cell is shown as mean ± SEM with individual cell values overlaid as gray dots.
